name: Sugawara Kimie
source:
Kimie is a treasurer of the student council and as such, she follows [url=/c10799]Takako[/url] around almost all the time. When they are not together, Kimie will go around investigating various matters and report back to Takako. Much like Takako, she has a very serious personality and would not stop at sticking up for Takako when need be.

[spoiler]She becomes the student council president for the next term in Takako's path. She is the seventy-third elder sister and her another name is Kaguya no Kimi.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
